name: jrichlen
description: Cross-harness agent plugin marketplace. Each plugin lives under plugins/<name>/ and is registered here for named installation.

plugins.name: graveyard
plugins.description: Archive old GitHub repositories into a single private graveyard repo as restorable git bundles, then safely delete the originals. Captures full history (branches, tags, PR refs) and never deletes an original until its backup is verified.

plugins.name: plugin-factory
plugins.description: Scaffold a new marketplace plugin skeleton in one command: valid plugin.json, invariant-first SKILL.md, AGENTS.md symlinks, command stub, and a red-by-default eval, wired into the marketplace.

plugins.name: tailscale-wif
plugins.description: Set up and troubleshoot secretless GitHub Actions -> Tailscale auth via Workload Identity Federation (WIF): GitHub OIDC exchanged for short-lived Tailscale tokens, with no stored API keys or OAuth secrets.

plugins.name: fleet-playbook-curator
plugins.description: Deploy daily GitHub automation that curates a living, self-invalidating operating index (a 'fleet playbook') for a glob of repos — always pointing at the repos as the source of truth, never posing as it.

plugins.name: dev-diary
plugins.description: Keep a scannable developer journal that writes itself: discover the day's work from sessions, commits and prompts, interview the user, record a dated entry. Ships /dev-diary and /dev-diary-review.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Route every response element to exactly one voice: prose to human-voice, machine-read artifacts to machine-voice; plus ai-writing-mistakes (wording pass) and second-opinion (offer-only validation).

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview the user about a plan before work starts, single-session and no subagents required, walking its design tree and scaling question depth to each branch's stakes (reversibility x blast radius) while offering a recommendation at almost every step. Use on "grill me" or "stress-test this plan".

plugins.name: tracer-bullets
plugins.description: Ship the thinnest end-to-end slice through a system first, then widen it in place — for both software delivery and open-ended investigation/research. Use when scoping new work or de-risking unknowns.

plugins.name: semver-gate
plugins.description: Classify a candidate action as PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR (semver-style blast-radius test) before acting, and rehearse the rollback of any irreversible one — name the restore path and exercise it. Use mid-task when unsure how much autonomy to take.

plugins.name: verify-before-claim
plugins.description: Never assert a fact, completion, or reproduction claim without naming and running the specific check that would prove it false, first.

plugins.name: diagnosing-bugs
plugins.description: Diagnose a bug by writing ranked, falsifiable hypotheses before any code change, tagging temporary debug instrumentation for a zero-tolerance sweep, and gating the regression test to a red-then-green proof at the confirmed seam. Use when fixing or root-causing a bug.

plugins.name: docs-hygiene
plugins.description: Audits CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/SKILL.md instruction files against current repo state, catches claims that have gone stale (a renamed path, a dropped command, a policy that changed) before they get trusted or acted on, and resolves contradictions between layered instruction files. Use to audit docs or when instruction files contradict each other.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Walk the ordered continue, clear, handoff, delegate, compact decision tree at a phase boundary, and keep any handoff artifact pointer-only — settled specs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, and diffs referenced by path or URL, never copied inline.

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Before writing a new interface (module boundary, class API, function signature, or service contract) that at least two call sites will depend on, that crosses a module/service/team/persistence boundary, or that will be expensive to change later — produce 3+ radically different candidate designs and compare them on depth, locality, and seam placement before picking one. Use for "design it twice".

plugins.name: wayfinder
plugins.description: Chart a multi-session effort as a labeled map of typed decision tickets (grilling / prototype / research / task) with explicit dependencies and an open frontier agents self-assign into. Plans; never executes.

plugins.name: scope-fence
plugins.description: Keep every hunk of the diff traceable to the stated task: out-of-scope discoveries become findings (ticket, note, diary entry), never same-change fixes.

plugins.name: find-before-build
plugins.description: Search for the existing implementation before writing a new one: name the searches run for an existing helper, abstraction, or pattern and what they returned.

plugins.name: egress-gate
plugins.description: Before any call that transmits repo or user content off-machine (posting a comment, pushing a branch, calling an external API with file contents in the payload), state what is being sent and to whom — permission modes gate the call, this gates the content.

plugins.name: stop-rule
plugins.description: A halting discipline for iterative fix loops: after a bounded number of failed attempts at the same objective, stop and report state with hypotheses.

plugins.name: redgate
plugins.description: Working harness for nontrivial work that needs explicit falsifiable criteria, verified ARM/TRACE/JUDGE rounds, or classified human gates.

plugins.name: recurrence-detector
plugins.description: Close the growth loop's DETECT step: cluster the exhaust every run sheds (stop-reports, scope-fence findings, unmet criteria, diary entries) by failure shape and surface repeat shapes as named candidate invariants. Proposes; never scaffolds. Use when asking what keeps going wrong.

plugins.name: jori
plugins.description: Coordinate complex work with bounded agents, evidence, and proportional dashboards.

plugins.name: agent-compiler
plugins.description: Compile deterministic, content-hashed agents from small behavior modules: a typed AgentQuery in, an immutable AgentImage and rendered harness-native subagent out; fails closed on conflicts.

plugins.name: eval-ladder
plugins.description: Design and audit an agent system's eval ladder — the cheapest rung that catches each regression, the blind spot beside every green, judges validated by TPR/TNR, pass^k for irreversible actions. Use when designing or auditing a test/eval strategy.

plugins.name: consolidation-map
plugins.description: Map a catalog consolidation by unit of work, not by file: one verb per entity, counts that must reconcile. Use for a "meta diff" or when merging or pruning plugins, skills, services or packages.

plugins.name: wave-research
plugins.description: Stress-test a contested thesis with staged, adversarial research (rival hypotheses, ACH matrix, checkpoints), plus fan-out research-and-verify Workflow templates. Not for lookups.
